evidence_location.quote: PBMCs from vaccinated volunteers were labeled with CFSE (Invitrogen), as previously described. 2 million cells were incubated in polypropylene snap-cap tubes (Falcon) in the presence of YF17D-derived peptide pools (Fig. S6 a) at a final concentration of 2 μg/ml/peptide, SEB (50 ng/ml; Toxin Technology) or nothing (nonstimulated; NS)... 5 d later (6 d total incubation), the cells were harvested and stained with anti-CD3, -CD4, and -CD8 antibodies (BD).
